content:
Bible Study Fellowship
Tuesday Nights at 6:50pm. More information can be found online at bsfinternational.org.

Senior Adult Bible Study
Join us on Thursday at noon. Bring a bag lunch and your Bible!

CHUPPER (Church + Supper)
Wednesday Nights at 5:30pm. Sign up at the Greeter Station. Cost is $2 per person with $10 max per family.

Baby Bottle Boomerang
The bottles need to be turned in by May 10th. Any checks should be written out to “Choices”.

On Thursday, May 21st the Young @ Heart will go to Polly’s Freeze in Georgetown, IN. We will enjoy lunch and some ice cream. We will meet at the church at 11:30am and carpool. Please let Pastor Kevin know if you plan to attend by Sunday, May 17th

VBS Volunteer Training
All VBS volunteers are required to attend the training on May 19th at 6:30pm. If you are unable to attend, please contact the church office.
